description: A targeted read of an existing element: find by name, get of the properties of the screen, usages of who uses it and a dump of the tree in two layers.

ops.name: UserProfile
ops._why: the name may exist in more than one type: find returns the type, name and key of each
properties of the screen (Title, Roles, inputs...)
who navigates to the screen: count, real and the path of each consumer
the layout tree of the screen: the placeholders where a new widget goes
